title: Louisiana Starlink hold: the 10,635-location agreement still precedes activation
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: The signed Starlink BEAD agreement covers 10,635 locations, but no compatible activation, installation, subscriber, capacity-reservation, test, affordability, adoption, complaint, or closeout result is public in the reviewed record. Denominator: The same 10,635-location agreement cohort across more than 50 parishes, kept separate from activated, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, or closed-out locations.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Adoption and activation hold.

Finding: The signed Starlink BEAD agreement covers 10,635 locations, but no compatible activation, installation, subscriber, capacity-reservation, test, affordability, adoption, complaint, or closeout result is public in the reviewed record.
Denominator: The same 10,635-location agreement cohort across more than 50 parishes, kept separate from activated, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, or closed-out locations.
Boundary: Agreement execution is not service activation.
Boundary: A delivery schedule is not an accepted result.
Boundary: No subscriber, capacity, performance, affordability, adoption, complaint, or closeout denominator is disclosed.
Next action: Reopen with location-level activation, installation, subscribers, capacity reservation, tests, latency, uptime, price, adoption, complaints, and accepted closeout.
why_it_matters: The visible hold prevents delivery, serviceability, planning, or component records from being presented as reliability, adoption, recurring output, accepted capacity, or a complete program baseline.
